title: Full Body + French Contrast
warmup: 2 rounds: 1:00 bike · 10 goblet squats · 10 walking lunges · 10 band pull-aparts
jumps: Goblet squat 5 → Box jump 5 → DB squat jump 5 → Fast pogos 10
Goblet @ RPE 7 · light DBs on the jump · max intent · rest 2:00

cond.subtitle: As many rounds as possible
cond.scaling: Push-ups from a box · lighter DBs

note: French contrast: every jump is max effort. If you slow down, stop the round.
